text.description_html:
RK International CK-2AC, Hammered Acrylic Cabinet Knob

When it catches the light, the Clear Acrylic Hammered Cabinet Knob sparkles with brightness. It is cut like a diamond to send the light's colors back into the room around it. The high quality acrylic from which it is made is known for its clarity. The base of the RK International's CK-2AC Hammered Acrylic Cabinet Knob is available in the 4 most popular finishes: polished brass, satin nickel, polished chrome (pictured), and oil rubbed bronze so you will be sure to find one you love and that fits your existing decor. Or maybe this little knob will inspire you to redecorate--it is so beautiful, it just might.

Specifications and Features of the CK-2AC Clear Acrylic Cabinet Ball Knob:

  • Material: acrylic with a brass rose
  • Diameter: 1-1/8"
  • Projection: 1-5/8"
  • Screw: 1" long #8 - 32 machine screw.
  • Packaged with all necessary installation hardware.

Sold Individually
